exclusions.source_text: Bilirubin2 = ≤1.5 x upper limit of normal (ULN) Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) = ≤ 2.5 x ULN Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) = ≤ 2.5 x ULN
exclusions.threshold: Bilirubin ≤ 1.5 x ULN; AST ≤ 2.5 x ULN; ALT ≤ 2.5 x ULN

exclusions.source_text: Ability to understand English or Spanish language as determined by the site investigator or protocol designee.

Severe or unstable angina, myocardial infarction, symptomatic congestive heart failure, arterial or venous thromboembolic events (eg, pulmonary embolism, cerebrovascular accident including transient ischemic attacks), or clinically significant ventricular arrhythmias within 6 months prior to randomization.
other benign CNS or meningeal disease which may require treatment with surgery or radiation therapy
Active infection (eg, human immunodeficiency virus \[HIV\] or viral hepatitis).

Participants with a prior or concurrent malignancy whose natural history or treatment does not have the potential to interfere with the safety or efficacy assessment of the investigational regimen are eligible for this trial.
